summary: Applied the three triaged blocking repairs: pass nextAction now targets finalize-commit, final-regression failure classification does not mutate implementation or test files, and invalid_project_test is a bounded test-repair route.

items.title: Pass nextAction conflicts with existing finalize step
items.rationale: Changed the pass artifact contract and acceptance text from finalize to finalize-commit so artifact nextAction matches the executable next flow leaf.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[2].desc now says nextAction=finalize-commit; acceptance_criteria[2] now says advances to finalize-commit; overview.data_flow[1] now says finalize-commit starts after pass.

items.title: Final-regression repair can stale prior evidence
items.rationale: Clarified that flow run final-regression never applies file-changing repairs. It emits routing artifacts only; any later user or agent edit is outside the command and remains subject to existing stale-artifact reset behavior.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[4].desc now states final-regression shall not mutate implementation or test files; clarifications[4] states the command emits nextAction only; acceptance_criteria[5] and tasks[1].acceptance require artifact/issue-log-only writes during failure classification.

items.title: invalid_project_test retry route is ambiguous
items.rationale: Aligned invalid_project_test with issue #330's test-repair path and the existing routing map; it is retryable once and then stops on the second final-regression failure.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[3].desc now states invalid_project_test routes to test-repair, not regression-repair; requirements[4].desc now names invalid_project_test as the first-failure test-repair path; acceptance_criteria[4] covers first and second invalid_project_test routing.
